observations: Photos 0, 1 and 2 show one used automatic transaxle (front-wheel drive automatic gearbox) with the torque converter fitted, sitting in a used auto parts yard among other engines and gearboxes.
The case is dusty and grimy with oil staining; it looks like a pulled used unit, not a new or like-new one.
Cooler lines and a hose marked SAE J1532 are attached (photo 0); this is a hose standard, not a make or model.
Paper labels on the case and a barcode sticker on the torque converter are visible in photos 0 and 2 but no text on them is legible.
No Ford logo, part number, casting number or transmission tag can be read in any photo.
Every photo carries a 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'GEARUP INC' watermark, so these are dealer listing photos.
No photo shows the item running, a test, a receipt or a warranty document.

identity.kind: used automatic gearbox (front-wheel drive transaxle) with torque converter

claims.evidence: No Ford mark, tag or part number is legible in photos 0 to 2; the shape fits a front-wheel drive automatic transaxle but fitment cannot be read.
Photos 0, 1 and 2 show a dirty, oil-stained used unit in a parts yard.
No close-up of case seams, pan bolts or factory seals is shown.
A loose gearbox cannot be shown working in photos; no test clip or bench report.
No receipt or warranty document is shown; a new-car receipt is unlikely for a pulled used unit.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment: the unit may not be the Ford Fusion 4 cylinder transmission, or may be a different variant
risks.proof: Close-up of the transmission ID tag or case casting with the part number legible
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced as a Ford Fusion gearbox

risks.risk: Internal wear or failure (slipping, harsh shifts, burnt clutches)
risks.proof: Clip of the unit running in a car or on a test rig through all gears, or a photo of the fluid on a white cloth
risks.if_unproven: as not working, core value only

risks.risk: Previously opened or rebuilt despite the claim
risks.proof: Close-up of the pan, bolts and case seams showing untouched factory sealant

risks.risk: Cracked case, damaged bell housing or missing sensors and solenoid connector
risks.proof: Clear close-ups of all sides of the case, the bell housing and the electrical connector
Photo of the written warranty terms with the dealer name and the code written in shot

proof_requests: Close-up of the transmission ID tag or part number on the case, legible
Clip of the gearbox running in a car or on a test rig, shifting through all gears
Photo of the transmission fluid on a white cloth
Close-ups of all sides of the case and the electrical connector
Photo of the warranty document with a handwritten code in shot
response.reason: The photos show a used automatic transaxle but no tag or part number is legible, and the fitment sets the price, so not even a worst case price can be retrieved until the ID tag is shown. The 'like new' claim is contradicted by the photos.
